Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
• Just now
You have the option to change the shipping address within 2 hours of purchase by accessing your order through the Account page.
Important: Address changes are only possible within the same state due to sales tax variations — requests to change the address to a different state will be denied.
If you notice an error before the order ships, you can contact our team immediately to request an update. While we can usually accommodate shipping address changes before the order is shipped, once the shipment is in transit, a shipping address change is not possible.
